source_title: NASA’s ESCAPADE Completes Powered Earth Flybys, Now En Route to Mars
source_excerpt: NASA’s two ESCAPADE (Escape and Plasma Acceleration and Dynamics Explorers) spacecraft have each successfully completed a powered Earth flyby, using Earth’s gravity in combination with a sustained engine burn to slingshot themselves toward Mars.
